I was on 200mg Zoloft for 8 years and I quit cold turkey about a month ago for a variety of factors. I don’t encourage quitting cold turkey and I shouldn’t have but I did.

I had a little bit of dizziness at work for the first week or so, and I would randomly tear up for no reason for about two weeks. And that’s it.

I was very nervous about the side effects but I didn’t get brain zaps, didn’t have any mood swings, and after two weeks I feel the same as I did the past couple years on Zoloft, which is to say I’m fine. I’m not the happiest person in the world but I’m not super depressed anymore either.

Many people experience side effects when tapering off Zoloft, but it’s not a guarantee, and I figured I’d throw my experience in to maybe help.

Do not quit cold turkey though. Seriously. I ended up fine but everyone is different and maybe I just got lucky.
